body.name: Relational endpoint certificate grammar
body.construction: \(Gamma\) is a tagged record containing an injective length-delimited digest of \(S,G,Rsrc,Psrc,rho,a,B,Ictx,K,F,Z\); local grounding and context-incidence records; a replayable sequence of truncated-factorization additions and multiplications whose dense output is \(F\); cleared integer numerator and derivative gcd data; disjoint rational isolators and Sturm root counts for every member of \(Ccrit\); boundary records; candidate-to-value links certified by resultants and Sturm--Tarski signs; shared labels for equal values; selected records \((qminus,L)\) and \((qplus,U)\); sorted rational-versus-algebraic breakpoint comparisons; and exact source and target evaluation records for both serialized model groundings in \(Z\).
